remaining_suppressions.reason: The method only tests the presence of two WooCommerce navigation flags; it reads no submitted value and mutates no data. Optional payment-method changes are handled separately and fail closed while their required adapter APIs are unavailable. Adding a new nonce to this read-only predicate would change the existing navigation contract.
remaining_suppressions.scope: one return statement; both presence checks on the same line

filename_handling: Canonical class filenames contain the class bodies; historical filenames are static require_once shims, retaining include compatibility without suppressing filename rules.
correctness_fixes: Use WooCommerce order/subscription CRUD for HPOS metadata reads, writes and deletions, and save changes.
Read saved_cards from woocommerce_plugnpaydirect_settings without recursively constructing Gateway.
Return controlled failure before absent Pre-Orders/source/3DS adapter methods are called; never return checkout success after a caught pre-order failure.
Retain the existing label if Customer::get_sources is unavailable; do not invent a vault API.
Reject malformed legacy identifier types before strpos and escape static validation exceptions.

verification.wpcs_compat: 0 errors / 0 warnings on the unchanged full WordPress ruleset
